title: Integrating ‘citizen science’ with experimental data helps uncover how plants adapt
summary_en: A research team led in part by an Iowa State University agronomy professor combined public data with designed experiments to discover how different variants of switchgrass adapt to their environment, causing the plant to flower earlier in northern latitudes.
title_cn: Integrating ‘citizen science’ with experimental data helps uncover how plants adapt

title: Artist residency shares unique art process with Des Moines students
summary_en: Named artist-in-residence with Ballet Des Moines, an Iowa State professor shared her unique process of weaving movement and art with Des Moines sixth graders.
title_cn: Artist residency shares unique art process with Des Moines students

title: Hands-on precision ag lessons yield ‘aha’ moments for Iowa high school students
summary_en: A program sponsored by Iowa State University’s Digital Ag Innovation Lab provides Iowa ag teachers the training, tools and curriculum to introduce high school students to the basics of precision agriculture.
title_cn: Hands-on precision ag lessons yield ‘aha’ moments for Iowa high school students
